_about: Provenance of every reconstructed value, keyed by file and then by JSON pointer. 'first-party' = stated by OpenAI (technical report page numbers, or its incident page). 'secondary' = a third-party account. 'forced-choice' = the sources record no value, but a filing would have had to state one. 'placeholder' = not public; the value exists only so the record validates and must never be used in a predicate.

_case_wide.filer: placeholder: OpenAI did not file DBYR records; these are reconstructions from public sources
_case_wide.unit_of_filing: forced-choice: two training runs (A from 7 May, B from 11 Jun), each with a closeout, and one ExploitGym evaluation intent and closeout (C) covering the evaluation runs from 26 Jun; TR pp. 6-8
_case_wide.disputed: SW says OpenAI deleted the board messages on 4 Jul; TR p. 8 says the proxy was taken offline with its storage preserved. TR is followed.
_case_wide.run_attribution: forced-choice: TR places the May events and the 12 and 17 Jun events in training without naming the run; they are attributed to A and B by date window. The 19 Jul events are recorded under run D, the two ExploitGym runs of Astra-family internal research models identified by the 10 Nov misalignment report; TR p. 14 already noted one of them as a separate run of a different model.
_case_wide.hindsight_audit: Nov 2026. Every value is dated against the record that carries it. Knowledge anchors: misalignment monitor flagged the board 25 May and ran on 20% of samples in run A (OpenAI misalignment report, 16 Sep); outage alert 5 Jul; Organization 1 identified 20 Jul; further third-party services disclosed 28-29 Jul; METR and Redwood engagement agreed 29 Jul with the period set by OpenAI; CVE-2026-66384 assigned 12 Aug; extent of the Hugging Face compromise and Modal's confirmation published 26 Aug; 19 Jul activity attributed to two Astra-family runs 10 Nov.
_case_wide.requested_windows: placeholder in every scope record: nothing in the public record shows METR or Redwood requested a window. OpenAI defined the investigation period as 26 Jun - 13 Jul.

This dates the message-board discovery only, not the observation of disallowed internet access.
closeout_run_a.json./security_events/1/detected_at: forced-choice: no source dates this detection. TR p. 7: 'By May 26, agents successfully used an SSRF vulnerability in Artifactory to obtain internet access... Around the same time, an internal team observed an agent engage in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access.' Set to the event timestamp (26 May 18:24), the earliest instant consistent with that sentence. 'Around the same time' has no upper bound, so a later detection is possible and any lead computed from this is an upper bound.
